title: run.skill.md should direct agents to use write_file for pure-insertion changes
description: Phase 3 of run.skill.md instructs agents to prefer patch_file for changes under ~20 lines, but does not distinguish between changes that remove or modify lines (where patch_file works) and pure insertions (where patch_file fails with orig_count=0). Two tool errors were incurred in this run before falling back to write_file.
proposed_resolution: Add a note to Phase 3 of run.skill.md: if the change is a pure insertion (no lines removed), use write_file instead of patch_file. patch_file does not reliably apply diffs with no removed lines.
